Hi Lauren,

CityTech is building the CitySummit '26 agenda and we wanted to propose a jointly branded track we’re calling "CityTrack: Building Responsible Edge AI". We think Redwood + AcmeCloud would be a strong co-host for the afternoon track (90 minutes sessions + a 3-hour demo floor presence).

High-level ask:
- CityTech provides a preferred slot on the main track (afternoon) and a shared 10x20 booth on the partner row.
- Partners split MDF and speaker slots.
- We can support 2 co-presenters + 1 moderated panel.

I attached a short proposal with suggested session formats and timelines (CitySummit-Track-Proposal.pdf).

Can your team confirm interest and high-level budget range by EOD Friday? If so, we can draft a mutual action plan and sponsorship terms.

Thanks — excited to explore.

Thanks Jonas — good questions. Quick answers:
- Base sponsorship fee for a co-hosted track + 10x20 booth is $60,000. That includes lead capture (scannable badges), one sponsor email (to pre-event list), and basic AV (screen + mic). Private meeting rooms are available as add-ons; we can reserve a 4x4 meet room for $2,000/day.
- Reimbursements: we can do a single sponsor invoice (CityTech invoice) and Net-30 payment. We typically reimburse approved MDF spends within 45 days; we can escalate to 30 days for partners on contract.
- Power/AV: standard island booth package (single 20A circuit; AV is HDMI feed only). If you need live GPU/rack demos, send specs and we’ll evaluate floor access.

I attached our sponsorship tiers and a line-item list (sponsorship_tiers.xlsx).

If that aligns, can you send a signed mutual action plan and a PO request so we can hold the slot?
